title: China
description: Four months on exchange in Beijing, and a little more time to explore.
note: In 2024, I spent five months in China, including four months on exchange at Tsinghua University in Beijing. Here are some of the places and moments I brought back with me.

title: England & Scotland
description: A month in the United Kingdom, from London to the Scottish Highlands.
note: I spent a month in the United Kingdom in 2024. These photos take in London, university towns, the coast, and a visit to Scotland.

title: United States
description: A collection of trips around the United States in 2025 and 2026.
note: Places and moments around the United States in 2025 and 2026: New York and New Haven; Chicago, Milwaukee, and Indiana; Las Vegas and the Grand Canyon; Seattle and Mount Rainier; San Francisco and the Maine coast.
